Consistent engagement in acts of reflection, forgiveness, and community can integrate into one's regular mindset, influencing their responsibilities towards others throughout the year. **Conclusion**: Annual religious observances can change one's perspective on their responsibilities towards others, especially when approached with depth and intentionality.
